title: JAGUAR DEBUTS EXCLUSIVE CHROMATIC MOMENTS PROGRAMME AT THE BRITISH MUSEUM BALL | Jaguar 2024 Media Newsroom

headings.text: JAGUAR DEBUTS EXCLUSIVE CHROMATIC MOMENTS PROGRAMME AT THE BRITISH MUSEUM BALL
London Red: A Celebration of British Creativity
Jaguar Type 01 Chromatic Moment, London Red
JAGUAR AT KNIGHTSBRIDGE: A PERMANENT EXPRESSION OF A NEW ERA

body: LONDON, 17 OCTOBER 2026: Jaguar today revealed the first public expression of its exclusive Chromatic Moments programme at the British Museum's Red Ball, marking a defining moment in the launch story of Type 01.

Making it's UK dynamic debut, the vehicle showcased one of just 60 Chromatic Moments examples that will be created globally. Hand‑painted and individually crafted, the appearance represented the first public display of a Chromatic Moments vehicle and demonstrated Jaguar's bold new vision for colour, artistry and creative expression.

Created by Jaguar's in‑house creative teams, each Chromatic Moment has been conceived as a curated artistic expression, and reflects Jaguar's commitment to craftsmanship, originality and a reimagined approach to modern luxury.

London Red is a colour inspired by Britain's cultural capital and Jaguar's own creative heritage. Drawing influence from London's iconic architecture, red‑brick streetscapes, gallery interiors and creative energy, the finish serves as a tribute to both Jaguar's past and its future ambitions. Developed exclusively by Jaguar's materiality and paint specialists, London Red celebrates 90 years of Jaguar creativity while expressing a bold vision for the road ahead. Rich, dramatic and unmistakably confident, the colour reflects the enduring connection between British artistry and Jaguar design.

Just 60 Chromatic Moments vehicles will be produced worldwide. Each vehicle is meticulously hand‑painted and individually finished, transforming every example into a highly collectible expression of Jaguar's creativity. Bespoke detailing throughout the vehicle, including laser‑etched signatures and carefully curated design touches, reinforces the programme's emphasis on craftsmanship and exclusivity.
French Ultramarine Blue: The Colour of Creative Rebellion
French Ultramarine Blue is the second bespoke Chromatic Moments colour developed exclusively for Jaguar.

Inspired by a hue celebrated throughout art history and revered since the Renaissance, French Ultramarine Blue draws influence from artistic pioneers including Monet and Van Gogh. Through Jaguar's advanced paint technologies, the colour delivers an unprecedented satin‑like anodised appearance that creates extraordinary depth and visual richness.
Never before seen within automotive design, French Ultramarine Blue embodies Jaguar's fearless spirit, creative confidence and determination to challenge convention.
Jaguar inspires like no other. Since 1935, it has been at its best when looking forward. A copy of nothing.

Jaguar's transformation is defined by Exuberant Modernism, a creative philosophy that underpins all aspects of the brand. It embraces bold designs, unexpected and original thinking, creating a brand character that will command attention through fearless creativity.
Jaguar Type 01's exuberant modernist design, pioneering technology and instinctive driving dynamics will underpin future Jaguar models. It forms part of JLR's portfolio of distinctive British brands.
